video_title: Giannis Antetokounmpo Talks Miami Heat 6 Straight Wins, Facing Bucks, If They've Proven Anything Yet

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Miami Heat's recent success and team focus
quotes.excerpt: I think the team did a great job just setting the tone.
quotes.quote: I think the team did a great job just setting the tone. Obviously, it was a huge night for the city of Miami, for the organization. There was a lot of celebrities in the house, some celebrities next to our bench. But at the end of the day, I think we did a good job taking care of business. In the third quarter, we let our effort take a step back, and at the same time, we got to learn playing being 20 or 30 up. That is one of the toughest things, not to relax, because it is human nature for you to relax.
quotes.social_post: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the challenge of maintaining focus during a blowout win: It is human nature for you to relax when you are up 20 or 30 points.

structured.context: Giannis Antetokounmpo reflects on the team performance and maintaining focus during a game against the Miami Heat.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his decision-making as a playmaker versus scorer
quotes.excerpt: If I have one guy in front of me, I tend to go.
quotes.quote: If I have one guy in front of me, I tend to go. If I have two or three guys in front of me, I pass.
quotes.social_post: Giannis Antetokounmpo breaks down his simple decision making process: If I have one guy in front of me I tend to go. If I have two or three guys in front of me I pass.

structured.context: Giannis Antetokounmpo explains his decision-making process when facing defensive pressure during a game.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on facing his former team
quotes.excerpt: I don't think it was weird. Basketball is basketball.
quotes.quote: I don't think it was weird. It wasn't weird. Basketball is basketball. I tried to go out there and tried to do whatever I could to help my team win.
quotes.social_post: Giannis Antetokounmpo says facing his former team was not weird: Basketball is basketball. I tried to go out there and tried to do whatever I could to help my team win.

structured.context: Giannis Antetokounmpo discusses his mindset while playing against his former team.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on team perception and staying grounded
quotes.excerpt: You're not as bad as people say you are. You're not as good as people say you are.
quotes.quote: You're not as bad as people say you are. You're not as good as people say you are. You're always somewhere in the middle. Keep your head down, keep working hard, keep on doing the right thing, keep on building good habits. In the third quarter and the fourth quarter, we did not build good habits because we took our foot off the gas, which was not good. Hopefully, we can lock in in practice and lock in in the next game.
quotes.social_post: Giannis Antetokounmpo on team perception: You are not as bad as people say you are. You are not as good as people say you are. You are always somewhere in the middle.

structured.context: Giannis Antetokounmpo talks about the importance of maintaining good habits and ignoring external perceptions of the team.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his professional approach to game days
quotes.excerpt: The only thing in my mind is how can I help my team win.
quotes.quote: Since I was a kid, when I play basketball, I try to lock in as much as I can. People that have been around me know how I operate on game days. I try not to say much. I try not to interact as much. The only thing in my mind is how can I help my team win and how can I do my job. It doesn't matter who I play. I could have been playing against my four brothers and my two sons. It doesn't matter. I try to do my best and try to do things that I've worked on and try to have fun.
quotes.social_post: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his game day mindset: I could have been playing against my four brothers and my two sons. It does not matter. I try to do my best and try to do things that I have worked on.

structured.context: Giannis Antetokounmpo describes his personal routine and focus on game days.
